name: @pulp/react
description: React reconciler host config targeting Vellum WidgetBridge — render React JSX natively through Yoga + Skia + Dawn, no DOM, no browser

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('src/bridge-globals.generated.d.ts','dist/bridge-globals.generated.d.ts')" && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --platform=neutral --external:react --external:react-reconciler --external:react-reconciler/constants.js --external:scheduler && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --platform=neutral --external:react --external:react-reconciler --external:react-reconciler/constants.js --external:scheduler
